risk_description: Simplification may obscure necessary due-process information
Assisted access may create demand that exceeds staffing capacity
AI synthesis may flatten minority signals or overstate weak evidence
Community partnership may become consultation without decision influence
Onboarding may improve starts without sustained adoption
Dashboard may narrow strategy to what is measurable
Governance review may slow needed action without clear thresholds
Frontline evidence may be ignored if it conflicts with executive commitments
